items.subject: Resident Manager opportunity | Leatherhead
items.summary: Recruiter Sam Shad is offering a Resident Manager role at a 200+ apartment development in Leatherhead, paying £35K plus benefits. It is on-site and includes around two Saturdays per month with days back in lieu.
items.action: Decide whether the role is of interest; if it is, reply to Sam asking for the full details and a quick conversation.
items.decisionNeeded: Whether Pete wants to explore the Resident Manager opportunity.
